title: Case 291: David Pauley, Ralph Geiger & Timothy Kern

sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血也被抽干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 看起来凶手费尽了心思来隐藏她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为无名女尸。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但确认了她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是 Casefile Presents 推出的全新系列节目，各大播客平台现已上线。

sentences.en: Please see the show notes for this episode on your app or on our website.
sentences.zh: 请在您的应用程序或我们的网站上查看本期节目的shownotes。

sentences.en: 37-year-old Jeff Shockling was watching television at his mother's house shortly after 7pm on Sunday, November 6, 2011, when he heard the doorbell ring.
sentences.zh: 2011年11月6日星期日晚上7点刚过，37岁的杰夫·肖克林正和母亲在家里看电视，这时他听到了门铃响。

sentences.en: It was an unexpected sound to hear at that time of day.
sentences.zh: 在一天的这个时间听到这个声音实属意料之外。

sentences.en: Jeff's mother lived in a rural area in Caldwell, Ohio.
sentences.zh: 杰夫的母亲住在俄亥俄州考德威尔的农村地区。

sentences.en: Strange visitors to the home were rare, and known ones would just let themselves in rather than knock or ring the doorbell firSt.
sentences.zh: 家里很少有陌生访客，熟人来访通常会直接推门而入，而不是先敲门或按门铃。

sentences.en: Jeff also thought it was odd that he hadn't heard a car pull up, meaning that whoever was at the door had arrived on foot.
sentences.zh: 杰夫还觉得奇怪的是，他没有听到有车停下的声音，这意味着门外的人是步行来的。

sentences.en: Suspecting that another member of the family was playing a prank on him, Jeff asked his 9-year-old nephew to go and see who was there.
sentences.zh: 杰夫怀疑是家里的其他人跟他开玩笑，便叫他9岁的侄子去看看是谁来了。

sentences.en: The boy got up and went to the door, while Jeff continued watching the game show Jeopardy.
sentences.zh: 男孩起身走向大门，而杰夫则继续看着游戏节目《危险边缘》。

sentences.en: A moment later, Jeff's nephew came running back and told Jeff,
sentences.zh: 过了一会儿，杰夫的侄子跑了回来，对杰夫说：

sentences.en: Still believing this was part of a prank his younger relatives had come up with, Jeff nevertheless went to the front door.
sentences.zh: 杰夫仍然认为这是年轻亲戚们想出的恶作剧的一部分，但他还是走到了前门。

sentences.en: Standing in the doorway was a man Jeff had never seen before.
sentences.zh: 站在门口的是一个杰夫从未见过的人。

sentences.en: He looked to be in his late forties, with a solid build, a short, salt and pepper beard, and a shoulder-length grey streaked hair.
sentences.zh: 他看起来有四十多岁，身材魁梧，留着短短的盐粒胡须，一头挑染成灰色的齐肩长发。

sentences.en: The man's face was pale and he fidgeted anxiously while holding his right arm across his body.
sentences.zh: 这名男子面色苍白，焦虑地扭动着身体，右手横在胸前。

sentences.en: His right shirt sleeve was soaked in blood, and so was his pant leg below.
sentences.zh: 他的右衬衫袖子被血浸透了，下面的一条裤腿也是如此。

sentences.en: David Pauley was ready for a fresh start.
sentences.zh: 大卫·保利已经准备好迎接新的开始。

sentences.en: For many years, he had been a man of consistency.
sentences.zh: 多年来，他一直是个生活很有规律的人。

sentences.en: The 51-year-old from Norfolk, Virginia, had married his high school sweetheart, Susan, after the two had parted ways for a time.
sentences.zh: 这位来自弗吉尼亚州诺福克的51岁男子，在与高中恋人苏珊分别一段时间后，最终和她结了婚。

sentences.en: David adopted Susan's son, Wade, and became a stable influence in the boy's life.
sentences.zh: 大卫收养了苏珊的儿子韦德，成为了这个男孩生活中稳定的精神支柱。

sentences.en: David modelled to Wade what a regular routine looked like,
sentences.zh: 大卫为韦德树立了规律生活的榜样，

sentences.en: eating the same breakfast every day and then going to work his 9-to-5 job as a warehouse manager and truck driver for a building materials distributor.
sentences.zh: 每天吃相同的早餐，然后去一家建筑材料分销商那里做仓库经理兼卡车司机的朝九晚五工作。

sentences.en: But after almost 20 years of working for the same company, David was suddenly left adrift after they had to downsize.
sentences.zh: 但在为同一家公司工作了近20年后，由于公司规模缩减，大卫突然失去了方向。

sentences.en: He struggled to find another long-term position, instead working various jobs here and there.
sentences.zh: 他很难找到另一份长期工作，只能到处打零工。

sentences.en: This became even harder after the financial crisis of 2007-2008, which was the most severe global economic crisis since the Great Depression almost a century earlier.
sentences.zh: 在2007-2008年金融危机之后，这种情况变得更加艰难，这是近一个世纪前大萧条以来最严重的全球经济危机。

sentences.en: The subsequent recession led to companies going out of business and a shortage of jobs for blue-collar workers like David.
sentences.zh: 随之而来的经济衰退导致许多公司倒闭，像大卫这样的蓝领工人面临工作短缺。

sentences.en: David's personal relationships also began to suffer.
sentences.zh: 大卫的个人关系也开始出现问题。

sentences.en: Eventually, in 2009, David and Susan divorced.
sentences.zh: 最终，在2009年，大卫和苏珊离婚了。

sentences.en: David moved in with his older brother Richard and his sister-in-law, sleeping in their spare bedroom.
sentences.zh: 大卫搬去和他的哥哥理查德以及大嫂同住，睡在他们的客房里。

sentences.en: The trio got along well, but David was looking for something more permanent.
sentences.zh: 三个人相处得很融洽，但大卫一直在寻找更长久的生活。

sentences.en: He was eager to get back on his feet and find a place of his own so he could properly begin the next chapter of his life, instead of feeling like a guest in someone else's home.
sentences.zh: 他渴望重新振作起来，找一个属于自己的地方，以便正式开始他人生的下一个篇章，而不是像个寄人篱下的客人。

sentences.en: While working short-term temp roles and occasionally having to borrow money from friends and family,
sentences.zh: 在做短期临时工作、偶尔不得不向朋友和家人借钱的同时，

sentences.en: David kept his hopes up for something better.
sentences.zh: 大卫对更好的生活保持着希望。

sentences.en: At the men's Bible study sessions he attended regularly, he prayed to find a steady job.
sentences.zh: 在他定期参加的男士圣经学习班上，他祈祷能找到一份稳定的工作。

sentences.en: He also searched actively, turning to the internet to look for his next possible career.
sentences.zh: 他还积极寻找，通过互联网寻找下一个可能的职业生涯。

sentences.en: On Sunday, October 9, 2011, David was trawling job listings on the website Craigslist when one in particular caught his eye.
sentences.zh: 2011年10月9日星期日，大卫正在分类网站Craigslist上浏览招聘信息，这时一条招聘信息格外吸引了他的眼球。

sentences.en: Wanted.
sentences.zh: 诚招

sentences.en: Caretaker for farm.
sentences.zh: 农场看护。

sentences.en: Simply watch over a 688-acre patch of hilly farmland and feed a few cows.
sentences.zh: 只需看管一片688英亩的丘陵农场并喂几头牛。

sentences.en: The farm is used mainly as a hunting preserve, is overrun with game, has a stocked three-acre pond, but some beef cattle will be kept.
sentences.zh: 该农场主要用作狩猎保护区，野味繁多，有一个库存充足的三英亩池塘，但也会饲养一些肉牛。

sentences.en: Nearest neighbour is a mile away.
sentences.zh: 最近的邻居在一英里外。

sentences.en: The place is secluded and beautiful.
sentences.zh: 这个地方偏僻而美丽。

sentences.en: It will be a real getaway for the right person.
sentences.zh: 对合适的人来说，这将是一个真正的世外桃源。

sentences.en: Job of a lifetime.
sentences.zh: 千载难逢的工作。

sentences.en: If you are ready to relocate, please contact ASAP.
sentences.zh: 如果您准备好搬迁，请尽快联系。

sentences.en: Position will not stay open.
sentences.zh: 职位不会一直空缺。

sentences.en: The job ad immediately appealed to David Pauly.
sentences.zh: 这则招聘广告立刻吸引了大卫·保利。

sentences.en: It would provide accommodation and enough income to live off.
sentences.zh: 它将提供住所和足以维生的收入。

sentences.en: Plus, David loved the outdoors and a quiet life.
sentences.zh: 另外，大卫热爱户外活动和宁静的生活。

sentences.en: Although he had close friends and family members he loved, he was content with being left to his own devices.
sentences.zh: 尽管他有深爱的挚友和亲人，但他满足于独处。

sentences.en: The ranch was situated in the foothills of the Appalachian Mountains, a scenic location where David could enjoy the natural world.
sentences.zh: 该牧场坐落在阿巴拉契亚山脉的山麓，风景优美，大卫可以在那里享受大自然。

sentences.en: David also had a slightly hippie-ish look, with wavy, shoulder-length hair and a bushy moustache, and he wasn't keen on changing his style for a more straight-laced position.
sentences.zh: 大卫还带着一点嬉皮士的风格，留着波浪状的齐肩长发和浓密的胡须，他并不热衷于为了更正统的职位而改变自己的风格。

sentences.en: If he was living alone on a ranch, then it wouldn't matter how he looked.
sentences.zh: 如果他独自一人住在牧场里，那么他的外表如何就无关紧要了。

sentences.en: The only catch was that the ranch was in the southern part of Ohio, two states away from where David currently resided in Virginia.
sentences.zh: 唯一的不足是，该牧场位于俄亥俄州南部，距离大卫目前居住的弗吉尼亚州隔了两个州。

sentences.en: But this didn't deter David at all.
sentences.zh: 但这并没有丝毫阻止大卫。

sentences.en: His lifelong best friend, Chris Maul, had moved to Ohio a couple of years earlier after his own divorce and was happy there.
sentences.zh: 他一生的挚友克里斯·毛尔在几年前离婚后搬到了俄亥俄州，并在那里过得很开心。

sentences.en: David and Chris had been friends since high school and always remained in contact, despite life taking them in different directions.
sentences.zh: 大卫和克里斯从高中起就是朋友，尽管生活将他们带向了不同的方向，但他们一直保持着联系。

sentences.en: The men were so close that they talked up to 50 times a day.
sentences.zh: 两人关系十分亲密，甚至一天通话多达50次。

sentences.en: They spoke so frequently that they even purchased walkie-talkies for the sole purpose of chatting with each other.
sentences.zh: 他们通话如此频繁，以至于专门买了几对对讲机，纯粹是为了互相聊天。

sentences.en: If David moved to Ohio, he'd be able to see his friend more often.
sentences.zh: 如果大卫搬到俄亥俄州，他就能更频繁地见到他的朋友了。

sentences.en: David replied to the job listing, writing,
sentences.zh: 大卫回复了这则招聘广告，写道：

sentences.en: I'm 51 years young, single male, I love the outdoors.
sentences.zh: 我今年51岁，单身男性，热爱户外活动。

sentences.en: I currently live in Virginia, have visited Ohio, and I really love the state.
sentences.zh: 我目前住在弗吉尼亚州，曾去过俄亥俄州，非常喜欢这个州。

sentences.en: Being out there by myself would not bother me, as I like to be alone.
sentences.zh: 独自一人呆在那里不会困扰我，因为我喜欢独处。

sentences.en: I own my own pickup truck, so hauling would not be a problem.
sentences.zh: 我有自己的皮卡车，所以搬运东西不是问题。

sentences.en: I can fix most anything, have my own carpentry tools.
sentences.zh: 我几乎什么都能修，有自己的木工工具。

sentences.en: If chosen, I will work hard to take care of your place and treat it like my own.
sentences.zh: 如果被选中，我会努力照顾好您的房子，把它当成我自己的家一样对待。

sentences.en: A few days later, David received a reply from the ranch owner, a man named Jack, who was also a preacher.
sentences.zh: 几天后，大卫收到了牧场主杰克的回复，杰克是一个名叫杰克的人，也是一名牧师。

sentences.en: Jack said that he'd received more than a hundred applications for the job and had narrowed his list down to three candidates.
sentences.zh: 杰克说，他收到了100多份求职申请，并将候选人名单缩减到了三人。

sentences.en: David was one of them.
sentences.zh: 大卫就是其中之一。

sentences.en: Jack had a few more questions for David, including whether he'd ever been arrested for a felony.
sentences.zh: 杰克对大卫还有几个问题，包括他是否曾因重罪被捕过。

sentences.en: David assured him that he had a clean record.
sentences.zh: 大卫向他保证自己有一份清白的记录。

sentences.en: Jack warned that the ranch didn't have cell coverage and asked if David was okay living in relative solitude.
sentences.zh: 杰克警告说该牧场没有手机信号，并询问大卫是否能适应相对隐居的生活。

sentences.en: David confirmed that he was.
sentences.zh: 大卫确认他可以。

sentences.en: Jack said that he'd let David know if he'd gotten a job by 2pm that Friday, making it clear that if David was hired, he'd need to start right away.
sentences.zh: 杰克说，他会在星期五下午2点之前让大卫知道是否得到了这份工作，这表明如果大卫被录用，他需要立即开始工作。

sentences.en: David's excitement at learning he'd made the shortlist was visible to those around him.
sentences.zh: 周围的人都能看出大卫得知自己进入候选名单时的兴奋之情。

sentences.en: His brother Richard noticed how David looked happier and more animated than he had in a long time.
sentences.zh: 他的哥哥理查德注意到大卫看起来比很长一段时间以来的任何时候都更加快乐和充满活力。

sentences.en: When Friday came, David sat waiting by the phone.
sentences.zh: 到了星期五，大卫坐在电话旁等待。

sentences.en: It didn't ring.
sentences.zh: 电话没有响。

sentences.en: David resigned himself to the fact that Jack must have chosen someone else.
sentences.zh: 大卫默认杰克一定选择了别人。

sentences.en: Then, hours after the deadline had passed, a call came through.
sentences.zh: 然后，在截止时间过去几个小时后，电话打了进来。

sentences.en: It was Jack.
sentences.zh: 是杰克。

sentences.en: David had the job.
sentences.zh: 大卫得到了这份工作。

sentences.en: David was ecstatic.
sentences.zh: 大卫欣喜若狂。

sentences.en: Wasting no time, he packed all of his clothes and most treasured possessions into a U-Haul trailer that his church had lent him the money to rent.
sentences.zh: 他没有浪费时间，把所有的衣服和最珍贵的物品打包进了一个U-Haul拖车里，这个拖车是他的教会借钱给他租的。

sentences.en: Then, on Saturday October 22, he hopped into his blue Dodge pickup truck and started the drive north to Ohio.
sentences.zh: 接着，在10月22日星期六，他跳上他的蓝色道奇皮卡车，开始驱车向北前往俄亥俄州。

sentences.en: David spent the night at a hotel in the neighbouring state of West Virginia.
sentences.zh: 大卫在邻近的西弗吉尼亚州的一家酒店过夜。

sentences.en: The plan was to meet Jack for breakfast the following morning at a chain restaurant in the Ohio town of Marietta.
sentences.zh: 计划是第二天早上在俄亥俄州玛丽埃塔镇的一家连锁餐厅与杰克共进早餐。

sentences.en: From there, Jack would take David to the ranch and show him around.
sentences.zh: 从那里，杰克将带大卫去牧场并带他参观。

sentences.en: Before going to sleep that night, David called his friend Chris Moore for a chat.
sentences.zh: 当晚睡觉前，大卫给他的朋友克里斯·穆尔打电话聊天。

sentences.en: Chris wished David good luck for his first meeting with his new employer and asked him to get in touch after he was settled in.
sentences.zh: 克里斯祝大卫与新雇主的第一次会面好运，并请他在安顿下来后联系他。

sentences.en: He also told David to forward on his address as soon as he had it.
sentences.zh: 他还告诉大卫一拿到地址就立刻转发给他。

sentences.en: David still didn't know exactly where the ranch was located, just the general area, and Chris wanted to drive down to visit the following weekend.
sentences.zh: 大卫仍然不知道牧场确切的具体位置，只知道大概区域，克里斯想在下一个周末开车去拜访。

sentences.en: But the next day, Chris didn't hear anything from David.
sentences.zh: 但第二天，克里斯没有收到大卫的任何消息。

sentences.en: He tried reaching out to him via his walkie-talkie and was met with silence.
sentences.zh: 他试图通过对讲机联系他，却只听到了沉默。

sentences.en: For two friends who spoke dozens of times every single day, this was a sudden and unexpected change.
sentences.zh: 对于两个每天都要交谈几十次的朋友来说，这是一个突然且意料之外的变化。

sentences.en: When David found out he'd gotten the job, Chris was the first person he called, saying it was the best thing to ever happen to him.
sentences.zh: 当大卫发现自己得到这份工作时，克里斯是他第一个打电话的人，他说这是他经历过的最好的事情。

sentences.en: The fact that he wasn't reaching out to let Chris know how the job was going raised immediate alarm bells.
sentences.zh: 他没有联系克里斯告知工作进展如何，这一事实立即敲响了警钟。

sentences.en: Chris called David's brother and got a contact number for David's new boss, Jack.
sentences.zh: 克里斯打电话给大卫的哥哥，得到了大卫新老板杰克的联系电话。

sentences.en: He then called Jack to ask how David was doing.
sentences.zh: 然后他打电话给杰克，询问大卫的情况。

sentences.en: Jack reassured him that David was settling in well and he'd just left him with a list of chores to take care of.
sentences.zh: 杰克向他保证，大卫适应得很好，他刚给他留了一张需要处理的杂务清单。

sentences.en: He said he'd let David know that Chris had called when he saw him the next day.
sentences.zh: 他说他明天见到大卫时会告诉他克里斯打过电话。

sentences.en: Despite this reassurance, several more days went by with no word from David.
sentences.zh: 尽管有此保证，又过了好几天，依然没有大卫的消息。

sentences.en: Chris called Jack again and this time he had some unexpected news.
sentences.zh: 克里斯再次给杰克打电话，这一次他听到了一些意想不到的消息。

sentences.en: Jack said that when he'd arrived at the ranch that day,
sentences.zh: 杰克说，当他那天到达牧场时，

sentences.en: David had repacked all of his belongings into his pickup truck.
sentences.zh: 大卫已经把他所有的物品重新打包到了他的皮卡车上。

sentences.en: David told Jack that he'd met a guy in town who was going to work on a drilling rig in Pennsylvania and David had decided he'd do the same.
sentences.zh: 大卫告诉杰克，他在镇上遇到一个人，要去宾夕法尼亚州的一个钻井平台工作，大卫决定他也这么做。

sentences.en: Chris didn't believe this for a second.
sentences.zh: 克里斯一点也不相信这种说法。

sentences.en: He knew there was no way David would have left Ohio without letting him know.
sentences.zh: 他知道大卫绝不可能在不通知他的情况下离开俄亥俄州。

sentences.en: By the time two weeks had passed with no word from David,
sentences.zh: 两周过去依然没有大卫的任何消息，

sentences.en: Chris phoned David's twin sister, Deborah.
sentences.zh: 克里斯打电话给大卫的双胞胎妹妹黛博拉。

sentences.en: The two siblings had always been close.
sentences.zh: 这两兄妹一直很亲密。

sentences.en: After Deborah married her second husband, she relocated interstate but always stayed in touch with David.
sentences.zh: 黛博拉与第二任丈夫结婚后，她搬到了外州，但一直与大卫保持联系。

sentences.en: She was one of the first people he called after receiving his new job.
sentences.zh: 她是接到他新工作电话的第一批人之一。

sentences.en: David had told her his new boss was a preacher and it felt like he was being spiritually directed towards finding peace.
sentences.zh: 大卫曾告诉她，他的新老板是一名牧师，他感觉自己正受到心灵上的指引去寻找内心的平静。

sentences.en: Deborah was happy for David, but she'd made him promise to visit her for Christmas in two months' time as she didn't like the idea of him spending the holiday alone.
sentences.zh: 黛博拉为大卫感到高兴，但她让他保证在两个月后的圣诞节来看望她，因为她不喜欢他一个人过节的想法。

sentences.en: When Deborah received Chris's call, it underscored her own growing concern.
sentences.zh: 当黛博拉接到克里斯的电话时，这加剧了她日益增长的担忧。

sentences.en: David had stayed in touch with Deborah during his journey to Ohio and she'd asked him to phone her after he was settled in at the ranch.
sentences.zh: 大卫在去俄亥俄州的途中一直与黛博拉保持联系，她曾要求他在牧场安顿下来后给她打电话。

sentences.en: She hadn't heard from him since.
sentences.zh: 自那以后她就再也没收到他的消息。

sentences.en: Deborah tried calling David herself, but all of her calls went through to voicemail.
sentences.zh: 黛博拉亲自尝试打电话给大卫，但所有的电话都转到了语音信箱。

sentences.en: She left several messages, which became increasingly panicked and desperate as time went on.
sentences.zh: 她留下了几条语音留言，随着时间的推移，这些留言变得越来越恐慌和绝望。

sentences.en: Deborah promised to David she would find him, saying,
sentences.zh: 黛博拉向大卫承诺她会找到他，并说道：

sentences.en: The stress of the situation caused Deborah to lose her appetite and she struggled to sleep.
sentences.zh: 这种状况造成的压力导致黛博拉食欲不振，并且难以入睡。

sentences.en: She spent several days trying to track her brother down by calling the hotel he'd stayed at on his way to Ohio and the business he'd hired the U-Haul trailer from.
sentences.zh: 她花了几天时间试图追踪她哥哥的下落，办法是打电话给他去俄亥俄州途中住过的酒店以及他租用U-Haul拖车的公司。

sentences.en: Neither were able to shed any light on David's whereabouts.
sentences.zh: 两者都无法提供关于大卫下落的任何线索。

sentences.en: Without a location for the ranch,
sentences.zh: 由于没有牧场的位置，

sentences.en: Deborah was unable to progress further in her search.
sentences.zh: 黛博拉无法在她的搜寻中取得进一步的进展。

sentences.en: Then, about a week after receiving Chris's call,
sentences.zh: 然后，在接到克里斯的电话大约一周后，

sentences.en: Deborah suddenly recalled something.
sentences.zh: 黛博拉突然想起了某件事。

sentences.en: David had told her that the ranch was in a town called Cambridge.
sentences.zh: 大卫曾告诉她，牧场在一个叫剑桥的小镇。

sentences.en: Deborah went to her laptop computer and typed Cambridge, Ohio into Google.
sentences.zh: 黛博拉走到她的笔记本电脑前，在谷歌上输入了“俄亥俄州剑桥市”。

sentences.en: A website for the town's local newspaper popped up and Deborah clicked on it then started scrolling through recent articles.
sentences.zh: 该镇当地报纸的网站弹了出来，黛博拉点击了它，然后开始滚动浏览最近的文章。

sentences.en: One that was published three days earlier on Tuesday November 8 caught her eye.
sentences.zh: 三天前即11月8日星期二发表的一篇文章引起了她的注意。

sentences.en: The headline read,
sentences.zh: 头条写道：

sentences.en: Man says he was lured here for work, then shot.
sentences.zh: 男子称自己被引诱至此工作，随后遭枪击。

sentences.en: On Sunday October 9, 2011,
sentences.zh: 2011年10月9日星期日，

sentences.en: 48-year-old Scott Davis was scrolling through Craigslist when he came across the same job ad that had caught David's eye.
sentences.zh: 48岁的斯科特·戴维斯正在浏览Craigslist时，偶然看到了吸引了大卫的那则同一招聘广告。

sentences.en: For the past 15 years,
sentences.zh: 在过去的15家里，

sentences.en: Scott had been living in South Carolina, but he'd grown up in Ohio and his mother still lived there.
sentences.zh: 斯科特一直住在南卡罗来纳州，但他是在俄亥俄州长大的，他的母亲仍然住在那里。

sentences.en: Her house was run down and in desperate need of repairs.
sentences.zh: 她的房子破旧不堪，急需修缮。

sentences.en: Scott and his fiancée both agreed that he should move back to Ohio to assist his mother for a while.
sentences.zh: 斯科特和他的未婚妻都同意他应该搬回俄亥俄州照顾母亲一段时间。

sentences.en: Scott ran a landscaping business and as it was getting close to winter, there would be little landscaping work in South Carolina anyway.
sentences.zh: 斯科特经营着一家园林绿化生意，随着冬天的临近，南卡罗来纳州无论如何也没有多少园林绿化工作了。

sentences.en: When Scott spotted the Craigslist ad seeking a living caretaker at a 688-acre cattle ranch in Ohio, it sounded perfect.
sentences.zh: 当斯科特在克雷格列表网站上看到一则招聘俄亥俄州一个688英亩养牛场全职看护人的广告时，听起来非常完美。

sentences.en: The work sounded easy enough that he'd still have time to help out his mother.
sentences.zh: 这项工作听起来挺轻松，他甚至还有时间去照顾母亲。

sentences.en: Scott typed a reply to the ad.
sentences.zh: 斯科特回复了这则广告。

sentences.en: Just over a week later, on Monday October 17, he received a response from the ranch owner,
sentences.zh: 一个多星期后，也就是10月17日星期一，他收到了牧场主的回复，

sentences.en: Jack.
sentences.zh: 杰克。

sentences.en: Jack liked the sound of Scott and said it would be fine if he spent the weekends at his mother's.
sentences.zh: 杰克觉得斯科特很合适，并表示如果他周末回母亲家的话也没问题。

sentences.en: He asked Scott whether he owned a truck or any farm tools and also requested a photocopy of his driver's license for a background check.
sentences.zh: 他问斯科特是否有卡车或任何农具，并要求提供驾驶证复印件以便进行背景调查。

sentences.en: Scott provided the copy and assured Jack that he had everything required.
sentences.zh: 斯科特提供了复印件，并向杰克保证他具备所有必需的物品。

sentences.en: After a few more emails back and forth,
sentences.zh: 经过几次邮件往来后，

sentences.en: Jack offered Scott the job.
sentences.zh: 杰克录用了斯科特。

sentences.en: Scott packed a trailer with his belongings, including clothes, stereo equipment,
sentences.zh: 斯科特在一辆拖车里装满了他的物品，包括衣服、音响设备，

sentences.en: and his beloved Harley Davidson.
sentences.zh: 以及他心爱的哈雷戴维森摩托车。

sentences.en: Jack had encouraged him to bring the Harley, telling Scott the area around the ranch was gorgeous and perfect for motorcycling.
sentences.zh: 杰克曾鼓励他把哈雷带来，告诉斯科特牧场周围的景色美极了，非常适合骑摩托车。

sentences.en: In early November,
sentences.zh: 11月初，

sentences.en: Scott hitched the trailer to the back of his pickup truck and headed for Ohio.
sentences.zh: 斯科特将拖车挂在皮卡车后方，朝俄亥俄州驶去。

sentences.en: On the morning of Sunday November 6,
sentences.zh: 11月6日星期天早晨，

sentences.en: Scott pulled up at a diner called Shoney's in the town of Marietta.
sentences.zh: 斯科特把车停在玛丽埃塔镇一家名为肖尼的餐馆外。

sentences.en: He'd made plans to meet Jack there for a breakfast meeting before heading to the ranch where he'd be living and working.
sentences.zh: 他计划在那里与杰克共进早餐，然后再前往他将要生活和工作的牧场。

sentences.en: When Scott entered the diner,
sentences.zh: 当斯科特走进餐馆时，

sentences.en: Jack was already waiting with a tall young man who looked to be in his mid to late teens.
sentences.zh: 杰克已经带着一个看起来十几岁中后期的身材高大的年轻人在那里等候了。

sentences.en: Jack introduced the boy as his nephew.
sentences.zh: 杰克介绍说这个男孩是他的侄子。

sentences.en: Jack was tall too, with a solid build.
sentences.zh: 杰克也很高，体格健壮。

sentences.en: He was middle-aged, perhaps around 51 or 52, with wispy salt-and-pepper hair that was longer at the back.
sentences.zh: 他是个中年人，大约51或52岁，留着稀疏的灰白相间头发，脑后较长。

sentences.en: He had a moustache and it looked like he'd recently shaved his beard.
sentences.zh: 他留着胡子，看起来不久前刚刮过胡须。

sentences.en: He'd missed a couple of spots where patches of facial hair remained.
sentences.zh: 他有几个地方没刮干净，还留着些许面部胡茬。

sentences.en: Jack was chatty over breakfast, asking Scott what belongings he'd packed for his new life.
sentences.zh: 吃早餐时杰克很健谈，问斯科特为他的新生活打包了什么行李。

sentences.en: His nephew didn't say much, instead focusing on his food.
sentences.zh: 他的侄子没怎么说话，只顾着吃东西。

sentences.en: After they finished eating, they prepared to go to the ranch.
sentences.zh: 吃完饭后，他们准备前往牧场。

sentences.en: Jack explained that the small road leading to the ranch was damaged and needed to be repaired before Scott could drive his truck on it.
sentences.zh: 杰克解释说，通往牧场的小路受损了，需要修好后斯科特才能开车进去。

sentences.en: Scott was to leave his vehicle in a parking lot in the town of Caldwell for the time being, while Jack showed him the ropes.
sentences.zh: 斯科特暂时把车停在考德威尔镇的一个停车场里，而杰克则带他熟悉情况。

sentences.en: Scott got in the back seat of Jack's white Buick La Sabre, while Jack took the passenger seat and his nephew drove.
sentences.zh: 斯科特坐进杰克那辆白色别克长风的后座，杰克坐在副驾驶座上，由他的侄子开车。

sentences.en: Jack chatted while his nephew kept his eyes on the road, telling Scott about foods he liked, the church he preached at, and his ex-wife.
sentences.zh: 杰克一路闲聊，而侄子则专心开车，他跟斯科特聊了自己喜欢的食物、他传教的教堂以及他的前妻。

sentences.en: The surrounding landscape became increasingly rural.
sentences.zh: 周围的风景变得越来越荒凉偏僻。

sentences.en: Soon enough, they were driving on a dirt road and Scott had no signal on his cell phone.
sentences.zh: 很快，他们开上了一条泥土路，斯科特的手机也没了信号。

sentences.en: After driving for about 15 minutes, they reached a heavily wooded area and Jack asked his nephew to pull over, saying, quote,
sentences.zh: 开了大约15分钟后，他们到达了一个树木茂密的地方，杰克让侄子把车停下，说道：

sentences.en: Drop us off where we got that deer at last time.
sentences.zh: 把我们放在上次抓到那头鹿的地方。

sentences.en: Jack told Scott he'd left some equipment they needed to repair the road down a hill near a creek and he needed Scott's help to get it.
sentences.zh: 杰克告诉斯科特，他把修路需要的一些设备留在了小溪附近的山坡下，需要斯科特的帮忙去拿。

sentences.en: The two men hopped out of the car while the teenager did a U-turn, then headed off again.
sentences.zh: 两人跳下了车，而那名少年则掉了个头，随后又开走了。

sentences.en: Scott followed Jack down the hill into the woods.
sentences.zh: 斯科特跟着杰克顺着山坡走进树林。

sentences.en: Soon they reached the creek but Scott didn't see any equipment.
sentences.zh: 不久他们来到了小溪边，但斯科特没看到任何设备。

sentences.en: Jack appeared to be lost and soon gave up, telling Scott,
sentences.zh: 杰克似乎迷路了，很快就放弃了，对斯科特说：

sentences.en: forget this, let's turn around and take the roadway.
sentences.zh: 算了，我们回去走公路吧。

sentences.en: Scott turned and began to retrace his steps, this time walking in front of Jack.
sentences.zh: 斯科特转过身开始原路返回，这次走在杰克前面。

sentences.en: Then he heard a click behind him, followed by the word, fuck.
sentences.zh: 接着他听到身后传来一声咔哒声，随后是一个词：他妈的。

sentences.en: Scott thought the click sounded like a gun misfiring.
sentences.zh: 斯科特觉得那个咔哒声听起来像是枪击发失败。

sentences.en: He spun around and saw Jack, his eyes cold, aiming a revolver directly at him.
sentences.zh: 他猛地转过身，看到杰克眼神冰冷，正用左轮手枪直指着他。

sentences.en: Jack pulled the trigger again right as Scott impulsively reached out and tried to grab the weapon.
sentences.zh: 就在斯科特出于本能伸出手试图夺枪时，杰克再次扣动了扳机。

sentences.en: The bullet hit Scott in his right elbow.
sentences.zh: 子弹击中了斯科特的右肘。

sentences.en: He began to run, the black leather baseball cap he was wearing falling off as he did so.
sentences.zh: 他开始奔跑，头上戴着的黑色皮革棒球帽也随之掉了下来。

sentences.en: He raced deeper into the woods with Jack in hot pursuit, firing at Scott again and again.
sentences.zh: 他向树林深处狂奔，杰克在后面紧追不舍，一次又一次地向斯科特开枪。

sentences.en: Scott heard four gunshots but none of them hit him.
sentences.zh: 斯科特听到四声枪响，但都没有击中他。

sentences.en: He ran until he couldn't go on anymore.
sentences.zh: 他拼命奔跑，直到再也跑不动为止。

sentences.en: It appeared that he'd lost to Jack.
sentences.zh: 看来他是被杰克给甩掉了。

sentences.en: Scott found a ravine and decided to hide there.
sentences.zh: 斯科特发现了一个沟壑，决定躲在那里。

sentences.en: As he sat low in the ravine, he heard a car passing back and forth on the nearby road.
sentences.zh: 当他低身坐在沟壑里时，他听到一辆车在附近的公路上来回开过。

sentences.en: He had no doubt it was Jack looking for him.
sentences.zh: 他毫不怀疑那是正在找他的杰克。

sentences.en: Scott was bleeding heavily but he continued to hide.
sentences.zh: 斯科特流血不止，但他依然继续躲藏。

sentences.en: As the day drew on,
sentences.zh: 随着天色渐晚，

sentences.en: Scott grew cold and hungry yet was too scared to emerge in case his attacker was waiting for him.
sentences.zh: 斯科特又冷又饿，但又太害怕而不敢露面，生怕袭击者正在外面等他。

sentences.en: Finally, after about seven hours had passed, he knew he needed to move if he wanted to live.
sentences.zh: 最终，大约七个小时过去后，他知道如果想活命就必须移动。

sentences.en: Night had fallen and Scott walked several miles in the dark before coming across a farmhouse.
sentences.zh: 夜幕降临，斯科特在黑暗中走了好几英里，才偶然发现了一处农舍。

sentences.en: He approached the house, terrified that it might belong to Jack.
sentences.zh: 他走近房子，心里极度害怕这可能是杰克的住所。

sentences.en: Knowing he had no other option, he knocked on the door.
sentences.zh: 深知自己别无选择，他敲响了房门。

sentences.en: It was answered by a young boy who was there visiting his grandmother.
sentences.zh: 来开门的是一个正在那里看望祖母的小男孩。

sentences.en: He alerted his uncle,
sentences.zh: 他惊动了他的叔叔，

sentences.en: 37-year-old
sentences.zh: 37岁的

sentences.en: Jeff Shockling, who came to the door and called 911.
sentences.zh: 杰夫·肖克林，杰夫来到门前并拨打了911。

sentences.en: As they waited for the police to arrive,
sentences.zh: 在等待警察赶到的间隙，

sentences.en: Scott told Jeff that he'd been attacked by a man who'd offered him a job.
sentences.zh: 斯科特告诉杰夫，自己遭到了一名曾给他提供工作机会的男子的袭击。

sentences.en: Scott believed that the man intended to rob him.
sentences.zh: 斯科特认为那名男子是想抢劫他。

sentences.en: After all, he'd known that all of his most prized possessions, including his
sentences.zh: 毕竟，对方知道他所有最宝贵的财产，包括他的

sentences.en: Harley Davidson, were piled up in a trailer attached to Scott's truck.
sentences.zh: 哈雷戴维森摩托车，都堆放在挂在斯科特卡车后面的拖车里。

sentences.zh: 县治安官

sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬·汉纳姆在大约

sentences.zh: 15分钟后赶到，斯科特向他重复了自己的遭遇。

sentences.en: But Sheriff Hannam was doubtful of Scott's claiMs.
sentences.zh: 但汉纳姆治安官对斯科特的说法表示怀疑。

sentences.en: For starters,
sentences.zh: 首先，

sentences.en: Scott said he'd been hired to work on a 688-acre cattle ranch, but there were no ranches even remotely close to that size in Noble County.
sentences.zh: 斯科特说他是被雇去在一个688英亩的养牛场工作的，但在诺布尔县根本没有哪怕规模接近这个数字的牧场。

sentences.en: There were plenty of large rural stretches of land, but they mostly belonged to mining companies.
sentences.zh: 那里有很多广阔的乡村土地，但大多属于矿业公司。

sentences.en: The sheriff was also slightly suspicious of Scott Davis himself.
sentences.zh: 治安官对斯科特·戴维斯本人也略存疑虑。

sentences.en: His long hair, scruffy beard and denim jacket, combined with references to his Harley Davidson, all pointed to him being a biker.
sentences.zh: 他长发、邋遢的胡须和牛仔夹克，再加上他提及自己的哈雷戴维森，这一切都表明他是个飞车党。

sentences.en: Maybe he'd gotten caught up in a drug deal that had gone awry.
sentences.zh: 也许他卷入了一场出了岔子的毒品交易。

sentences.en: While Scott was taken to hospital in an ambulance, investigators began following up on his claim.
sentences.zh: 当斯科特被救护车送往医院时，调查人员开始跟进他的说法。

sentences.en: They called some local informants to see if they knew anything about the case.
sentences.zh: 他们打电话给一些当地线人，看他们是否了解此案的任何情况。

sentences.en: They didn't.
sentences.zh: 他们并不知道。

sentences.en: Investigators then went out to the
sentences.zh: 随后调查人员前往了

sentences.en: Caldwell parking lot where
sentences.zh: 考德威尔停车场，

sentences.en: Scott said he'd left his truck and trailer.
sentences.zh: 斯科特曾说他把卡车和拖车留在了那里。

sentences.en: Both were still there, exactly as he'd described.
sentences.zh: 两样东西都还在那里，完全和他描述的一样。

sentences.en: On the dashboard of the truck were printouts of the emails
sentences.zh: 在卡车的仪表盘上，放着

sentences.en: Scott had exchanged with his prospective employer,
sentences.zh: 斯科特与他未来的雇主

sentences.en: All the details were pointing to his story being true.
sentences.zh: 往来邮件的打印件。

sentences.en: About half a mile from his residence, there was some heavy equipment by the road that Scott had described seeing.

sentences.en: I am the only one with a gun.
sentences.zh: 我是唯一有枪的人。

sentences.en: Daniel found this suspicious.
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔觉得这很可疑。

sentences.en: He tried to find the ranch's details on the
sentences.zh: 他试图在诺布尔

sentences.en: Noble County Auditor's website, but nothing came up.
sentences.zh: 县审计员的网站上查找牧场的详细信息，但什么也没查到。

sentences.en: Concerned, Daniel told Beasley, quote,
sentences.zh: 感到担忧的丹尼尔对比斯利说，引述：

sentences.en: This ain't adding up.
sentences.zh: 这根本说不通。

sentences.en: The final straw came when Beasley offered to buy Daniel's SUV and pickup truck.
sentences.zh: 压垮骆驼的最后一根稻草是比斯利提出要买下丹尼尔的SUV和皮卡。

sentences.en: He said he'd pick them up and then give
sentences.zh: 他说他会去取车，然后等

sentences.en: Daniel the money once he arrived at the ranch.
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔到达牧场时再付钱给他。

sentences.en: Daniel disliked this plan, saying to Beasley,
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔不喜欢这个计划，对比斯利说：

sentences.en: What if somebody is trying to get my vehicles before I come down there, and then when I get down there, they shoot me and take my stuff?
sentences.zh: 万一在我去那儿之前有人想弄走我的车，等我到了那儿，他们开枪打死我并抢走我的东西呢？

sentences.en: Beasley responded,
sentences.zh: 比斯利回应道：

sentences.en: You shouldn't have said that.
sentences.zh: 你不该这么说。

sentences.en: He then sent Daniel an email formally rescinding the job offer.
sentences.zh: 随后他给丹尼尔发了一封电子邮件，正式撤回了工作机会。

sentences.en: Around the same time, Beasley was also talking to another man named George.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，比斯利还在与另一个名叫乔治的男子交谈。

sentences.en: Semi-retired and seeking an easy job to supplement his income, George thought
sentences.zh: 乔治处于半退休状态，正在寻找一份轻松的工作来增加收入，他觉得

sentences.en: Beasley's ad sounded ideal.
sentences.zh: 比斯利的广告听起来很理想。

sentences.en: The two met at a food court to talk specifics.
sentences.zh: 两人在美食广场见面讨论具体细节。

sentences.en: The interview was going well until George mentioned that he'd been involved with martial arts for almost his entire life.
sentences.zh: 面试进展顺利，直到乔治提到他几乎一生都参与武术活动。

sentences.en: Beasley suddenly sat back in his chair.
sentences.zh: 比斯利突然靠在椅子上。

sentences.en: When George added that he'd previously worked as a security guard, Beasley put George's application away and abruptly ended the interview.
sentences.zh: 当乔治补充说他以前当过保安时，比斯利收起了乔治的申请表并突然结束了面试。

sentences.en: George never heard from him again.
sentences.zh: 乔治再也没有听到过他的消息。

sentences.en: David Pauley was the first successful candidate.
sentences.zh: 戴维·保利是第一个成功的候选人。

sentences.en: Early on the morning of Sunday October 23, mere hours before David was set to meet them in Ohio,
sentences.zh: 10月23日星期日清晨，就在戴维准备在俄亥俄州与他们会面的几小时前，

sentences.en: Richard Beasley enlisted Brogan Rafferty's help once again.
sentences.zh: 理查德·比斯利再次寻求布罗根·拉弗蒂的帮助。

sentences.en: They'd bought some shovels and drove out to the general area where Ralph Geiger was buried.
sentences.zh: 他们买了一些铁锹，开车前往埋葬拉尔夫·盖格的大致区域。

sentences.en: While Beasley supervised, Brogan dug a grave.
sentences.zh: 在比斯利的监督下，布罗根挖了一个墓穴。

sentences.en: Later that morning, Beasley and Brogan headed to the chain restaurant where they'd arranged to meet David.
sentences.zh: 那天上午晚些时候，比斯利和布罗根前往他们安排与戴维会面的连锁餐厅。

sentences.en: Afterwards, the duo embarked on what would become a pattern.
sentences.zh: 之后，两人开始了后来成为惯例的行动。

sentences.en: Beasley explained that the road to the ranch was damaged so they'd have to repair it before coming back for David's things.
sentences.zh: 比斯利解释说通往牧场的路坏了，所以他们得先修路，然后才能回来拿戴维的东西。

sentences.en: Brogan then drove Beasley and David out to the location of the pre-dug grave.
sentences.zh: 接着布罗根开车把比斯利和戴维带到预先挖好的墓穴所在地。

sentences.en: After Brogan pulled over, the three got out of the car and Beasley asked Brogan and David to follow him up a hill.
sentences.zh: 在布罗根靠边停车后，三人下了车，比斯利要求布罗根和戴维跟着他上山。

sentences.en: Brogan stopped to urinate and as he was finishing, he heard a cracking sound.
sentences.zh: 布罗根停下来小便，快结束时，他听到了一声脆响。

sentences.en: He turned around and saw David poorly lying face down on the ground, having been shot in the back of the head.
sentences.zh: 他转过身去，看到戴维面朝下趴在地上，后脑勺中枪。

sentences.en: After Brogan buried David, he and Beasley returned to the parking lot where David's blue Dodge pickup truck and trailer were parked.
sentences.zh: 布罗根埋葬大卫后，他和比斯利回到了停车场，大卫的蓝色道奇皮卡车和拖车就停在那里。

sentences.en: Beasley told acquaintances that he'd acquired the items by bidding on a storage unit and winning its contents.
sentences.zh: 比斯利告诉熟人，这些东西是他通过竞标一个仓储单元并赢得里面的物品所得。

sentences.en: He gave some of David's less valuable possessions away and sold others to neighbours and at flea markets.
sentences.zh: 他把大卫一些价值较低的物品送了人，其余的则卖给了邻居和跳蚤市场。

sentences.en: None of them were particularly high value.
sentences.zh: 这些东西都没有特别高的价值。

sentences.en: David had packed some model trains, fishing tackle boxes, a laptop, and a bit of NASCAR memorabilia.
sentences.zh: 大卫打包了一些火车模型、钓鱼工具箱、一台笔记本电脑以及一些纳斯卡赛车的纪念品。

sentences.en: Beasley also sold David's truck for $1,000 and made sure to return David's rented trailer to a U-Haul facility.
sentences.zh: 比斯利还以1000美元的价格卖掉了大卫的卡车，并确保将大卫租来的拖车归还给了U-Haul租赁点。

sentences.en: Two weeks later, Brogan accompanied Beasley to a breakfast meeting with 48-year-old Scott Davis.
sentences.zh: 两周后，布罗根陪同比斯利与48岁的斯科特·戴维斯会面吃早餐。

sentences.en: Beasley was particularly excited about this candidate given that he owned a Harley Davidson, which Beasley had told him to bring to Ohio.
sentences.zh: 比斯利对这位候选人特别兴奋，因为他拥有一辆哈雷戴维森摩托车，比斯利曾告诉他把车带到俄亥俄州来。

sentences.en: The plan proceeded much like the previous one had until Beasley went to shoot Scott and his revolver jammed.
sentences.zh: 计划的进行与之前的大同小异，直到比斯利准备枪杀斯科特时，他的左轮手枪卡壳了。

sentences.en: Hearing the weapon misfire gave Scott a heads up and time to run away.
sentences.zh: 听到武器哑火，斯科特有了防备，并赢得了逃跑的时间。

sentences.en: Beasley raced back to the road where Brogan was waiting in his car and told the team that if they saw Scott, they had to run him down.
sentences.zh: 比斯利跑回大卫在车里等待的路上，告诉同伙如果看到斯科特，必须开车撞死他。

sentences.en: The pair drove back and forth looking for Scott but eventually gave up.
sentences.zh: 两人来回开车搜寻斯科特，但最终放弃了。

sentences.en: As they headed back home,
sentences.zh: 在他们开车回家的路上，

sentences.en: Beasley threw some of the car's contents out the window so that his vehicle would be less recognisable if Scott described its contents to investigators.
sentences.zh: 比斯利把车里的一些东西扔出窗外，这样如果斯科特向调查人员描述车内物品，他的车就不那么容易被认出来了。

sentences.en: Beasley was devastated that his plan had gone awry.
sentences.zh: 比斯利对计划的搞砸感到心碎欲绝。

sentences.en: As well as the Harley,
sentences.zh: 除了那辆哈雷，

sentences.en: Scott had packed some high-end electronics and Beasley had estimated he'd make about $30,000 from selling it all.
sentences.zh: 斯科特还打包了一些高端电子产品，比斯利估计把这些全部卖掉能赚大约3万美元。

sentences.en: Despite the likelihood that police would soon be investigating the attempted murder, he decided he needed to make up for his unexpected loss.
sentences.zh: 尽管警方很快就会调查这起谋杀未遂案，但他决定必须弥补这笔意外的损失。

sentences.en: Richard Beasley went looking for another victim.
sentences.zh: 理查德·比斯利开始寻找另一个受害者。

sentences.en: 47-year-old Timothy Kern was going through a rough period.
sentences.zh: 47岁的蒂莫西·克恩正经历着一段艰难时期。

sentences.en: The divorced father of three from Akron had once been a successful club DJ but had been let go in 2001.
sentences.zh: 这位来自阿克伦的离异三子父亲曾是一名成功的俱乐部DJ，但在2001年被解雇了。

sentences.en: In the years that followed, he'd struggled to find consistent work.
sentences.zh: 在随后的几年里，他一直难以找到稳定的工作。

sentences.en: He eventually found a job as a street cleaner but by November 2011, he was unemployed again and had no fixed address.
sentences.zh: 他最终找到了一份清洁工的工作，但到了2011年11月，他又失业了，且居无定所。

sentences.en: He alternated between staying with friends and living out of his car while searching for a new job.
sentences.zh: 他在寻找新工作的同时，在朋友家借住和睡在车里之间来回过活。

sentences.en: When he came across Richard Beasley's Craigslist ad, he described it as a good offer but strange and wasn't as immediately enthusiastic as some of the other applicants.
sentences.zh: 当他看到理查德·比斯利的Craigslist广告时，他形容这是一份好工作但很奇怪，并不像其他求职者那样表现得那么热切。

sentences.en: The job would mean relocating to an area with limited cell service and a significant distance from his sons.
sentences.zh: 这份工作意味着要搬到一个手机信号有限、距离儿子们很远的地方。

sentences.en: Although Timothy hadn't lived with his sons since his divorce 14 years prior, he remained a huge presence in their lives.
sentences.zh: 尽管蒂莫西自14年前离婚以来就没有和儿子们住在一起，但在他们的生活中，他依然扮演着非常重要的角色。

sentences.en: He called and texted them almost every hour of every day and did his best to see them every single day, even if their visits were sometimes fleeting.
sentences.zh: 他几乎每小时都会给他们打电话发短信，并尽最大努力每天都能见到他们，即使他们的相聚有时只是匆匆一面。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, November 9, 2011, three days after the attack on Scott Davis,
sentences.zh: 2011年11月9日，星期三，在袭击斯科特·戴维斯三天后，

sentences.en: Timothy Kern met Richard Beasley for a job interview.
sentences.zh: 蒂莫西·克恩与理查德·比斯利进行了工作面试。

sentences.en: He got the job and on Sunday, November 13, he set off to start his new position.
sentences.zh: 他得到了这份工作，并于11月13日星期日出发去开始他的新工作。

sentences.en: Beasley and Brogan picked Timothy up in a parking lot in Canton, Ohio early the next morning.
sentences.zh: 第二天清晨，比斯利和布罗根在俄亥俄州坎顿的一个停车场接上了蒂莫西。

sentences.en: Beasley began asking Timothy about the items he'd brought with him, having previously established that Timothy owned a laptop and a flat screen TV.
sentences.zh: 比斯利开始盘问蒂莫西带来的物品，此前他已经确定蒂莫西拥有一台笔记本电脑和平板电视。

sentences.en: Timothy said he just had an old television and some garbage bags filled with clothes and cassette tapes.
sentences.zh: 蒂莫西说他只有一台旧电视和几个装满衣服与磁带的垃圾袋。

sentences.en: He explained that he'd given the laptop and more expensive television to his sons.
sentences.zh: 他解释说，他把笔记本电脑和较贵的那台电视留给了儿子们。

sentences.en: Beasley asked Timothy how much cash he had on him to get by until his first paycheck.
sentences.zh: 比斯利问蒂莫西身上有多少现金，够不够撑到拿到第一个月的薪水。

sentences.en: Somewhat sheepishly,
sentences.zh: 有些不好意思地，

sentences.en: Timothy said he only had $5.
sentences.zh: 蒂莫西说他身上只有5美元。

sentences.en: Brogan later told investigators that he felt a pit in his stomach at this point, realising that they were about to murder Timothy Kern for absolutely nothing.
sentences.zh: 布罗根后来告诉调查人员，此时他感到胃里一阵翻江倒海，意识到他们即将为了完全没有任何价值的东西谋杀蒂莫西·克恩。

sentences.en: But they still went ahead with the plan.
sentences.zh: 但他们还是继续执行了计划。

sentences.en: It was still dark when the trio headed off in Beasley's vehicle at around 6am.
sentences.zh: 清晨6点左右三人乘比斯利的汽车出发时，天色依然很黑。

sentences.en: This time,
sentences.zh: 这一次，

sentences.en: Brogan drove them to a wooded area behind a disused mall in Akron, which had gone out of business during the recession.
sentences.zh: 布罗根开车把他们带到了阿克伦一个废弃商场后面的树林里，那个商场在经济衰退期间已经倒闭了。

sentences.en: The previous killing site was too dangerous, given there had been several news articles published about the attempt on Scott Davis' life.
sentences.zh: 鉴于已经有多篇关于试图谋杀斯科特·戴维斯的新闻报道发表，以前的行凶地点太危险了。

sentences.en: Beasley explained to Timothy that they'd been squirrel hunting behind the mall earlier and he'd lost his watch.
sentences.zh: 比斯利向蒂莫西解释说，他们之前一直在商场后面打松鼠，他不小心把手表弄丢了。

sentences.en: He wanted to find it as it had sentimental value.
sentences.zh: 他想把它找回来，因为这块手表对他有感伤的价值。

sentences.en: Timothy followed Beasley into the woods and not long after,
sentences.zh: 蒂莫西跟着比斯利走进树林，不久之后，

sentences.en: Brogan heard a gunshot.
sentences.zh: 布罗根听到了一声枪响。

sentences.en: He looked over and saw Timothy on his knees, a hand clutching one side of his head.
sentences.zh: 他转过头去，看到蒂莫西跪在地上，一只手捂着头部的一侧。

sentences.en: Are you okay?
sentences.zh: 你没事吧？

sentences.en: Beasley asked in a concerned-sounding voice.
sentences.zh: 比斯利用关切的语气问道。

sentences.en: He then fired four more times, hitting Timothy in the head and killing him.
sentences.zh: 随后他又开枪四次，击中蒂莫西的头部，将其杀害。

sentences.en: They buried his body in a shallow grave
sentences.zh: 他们将他的尸体埋在了一个浅坑里，

sentences.en: Beasley had Brogan dig the night before.
sentences.zh: 这个坑是比斯利让布罗根在前一天晚上挖好的。

sentences.en: Brogan described to investigators where the bodies of Timothy Kern and Ralph Geiger were buried.
sentences.zh: 布罗根向调查人员指认了蒂莫西·克恩和拉尔夫·盖格的尸体埋藏地点。

sentences.en: Officers recovered them both and found that their injuries matched Brogan's version of events.
sentences.zh: 警官们找回了两人的遗体，并发现他们的伤情与布罗根描述的经过相符。

sentences.en: Ralph had sustained one gunshot wound to his head while Timothy had sustained five.
sentences.zh: 拉尔夫头部中了一枪，而蒂莫西则中了五枪。

sentences.en: By the time this information came to light,
sentences.zh: 正当这些信息浮出水面之际，

sentences.en: Richard Beasley was already in custody, having been arrested on his outstanding warrants on November 16, the same day that Brogan Rafferty was arrested and just two days
sentences.zh: 理查德·比斯利已经被拘留，他因未执行的逮捕令于11月16日被捕，也就是布罗根·拉斐尔被捕的同一天，距离

sentences.en: after Timothy Kern was killed.
sentences.zh: 蒂莫西·克恩遇害仅两天。

sentences.en: Investigators were able to track him down after he left a note for his former landlord
sentences.zh: 调查人员在比斯利给前房东

sentences.en: Joe Bayes.
sentences.zh: 乔·贝斯留下一张字条后顺藤摸瓜找到了他。

sentences.en: In it,
sentences.zh: 在字条中，

sentences.en: Beasley said he'd heard that police had been sniffing around and wanted to know what Joe knew.
sentences.zh: 比斯利说他听说警方一直在四处打听，想知道乔了解什么情况。

sentences.en: He'd asked Joe to call him and provided his cell phone number.
sentences.zh: 他让乔打电话给他，并留下了自己的手机号码。

sentences.en: Detectives had Joe phone Beasley for a chat while they hurriedly traced the call to a house in Akron.
sentences.zh: 侦探们让乔打电话给比斯利聊天，同时他们紧急追踪了这通电话，锁定了阿克伦的一处房子。

sentences.en: It turned out
sentences.zh: 原来，

sentences.en: Beasley had been renting a room he'd found by placing a room wanted ad on CraigsliSt.
sentences.zh: 比斯利一直租住在一个房间里，那是他通过在Craigslist上发布求租广告找到的。

sentences.en: Beasley wasn't talking but a search of his new residence uncovered a number of items belonging to David Pawley as well as mail addressed to Ralph Geiger and prescription bottles
sentences.zh: 比斯利闭口不言，但对他的新住所的搜查却发现了一批属于大卫·保利的物品，以及写有拉尔夫·盖格名字的信件和带有

sentences.en: with Ralph's name on them.
sentences.zh: 拉尔夫名字的药瓶。

sentences.en: While Beasley was held on remand, he sent a letter to a woman he was friends with.
sentences.zh: 在比斯利被还押候审期间，他给一位女性朋友写了一封信。

sentences.en: He asked her to go to his former residence at night time where he'd hidden two laptops under some leaves in the corner of the yard.
sentences.zh: 他让她在夜里去他以前的住所，他在院子角落的树叶下藏了两台笔记本电脑。

sentences.en: Beasley wanted her to destroy both computers as well as a wallet he'd hidden in another area of the yard.
sentences.zh: 比斯利想让她毁掉这两台电脑以及他藏在院子另一处的钱包。

sentences.en: He included a hand-drawn map of where to find these iteMs.
sentences.zh: 他在信中附上了一张手绘地图，标明了这些物品的藏匿地点。

sentences.en: Beasley asked his friend not to tell anyone about his letter and even concocted a secret code she could use to communicate whether her mission had been successful or not.
sentences.zh: 比斯利要求他的朋友不要把这封信告诉任何人，甚至还设计了一个秘密暗号，供她用来传达任务是否成功。

sentences.en: Instead of doing as requested,
sentences.zh: 比斯利的朋友没有照办，

sentences.en: Beasley's friend handed the information over to the police.
sentences.zh: 而是将这些情报交给了警方。

sentences.en: They retrieved the items, which turned out to be Ralph Geiger's wallet and David Pawley's laptop, as well as Beasley's own laptop with a record of his Craigslist activity.
sentences.zh: 他们找回了这些物品，经证实分别是拉尔夫·盖格的钱包和大卫·保利的笔记本电脑，还有比斯利自己的笔记本电脑，里面记录着他在Craigslist上的活动痕迹。

sentences.en: Richard Beasley maintained his innocence, a claim which was publicly supported by his mother.
sentences.zh: 理查德·比斯利坚称自己无罪，这一说法得到了他母亲的公开支持。

sentences.en: She told the
sentences.zh: 她告诉

sentences.en: Associated Press that her son had a very caring heart and was a mentor to
sentences.zh: 美联社，她的儿子有一颗非常慈爱的心，并且一直是

sentences.en: Brogan Rafferty.
sentences.zh: 布罗根·拉斐尔的导师。

sentences.en: As far as she knew, the two spent their time together going to church, fishing, playing video games and delivering food to people in need.
sentences.zh: 据她所知，两人在一起的时间都用来去教堂、钓鱼、玩电子游戏以及给有需要的人送食物。

sentences.en: At Richard Beasley's trial in late
sentences.zh: 在理查德·比斯利于2013年
